recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色下，一個卵圓形濾泡的中央（生發中心）呈中等棕色陽性，外圍一圈外套區染色較深且較暗，濾泡間區也有陽性細胞，勾勒出正常濾泡的生發中心與外套區分層。
features: Oval follicle with moderately positive brown staining of the germinal center
Darker, more intensely stained ring corresponding to the mantle zone
Positive cells also in the surrounding interfollicular/outer zone
Scattered unstained clear spaces and small vessels
Low magnification; specific antigen not identified in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of lymphoid tissue at low power shows an oval follicle in which the germinal center is moderately positive, surrounded by a more intensely and darkly staining mantle zone, with additional positive cells in the surrounding tissue. Unstained spaces and vessels are scattered throughout. The antigen is not specified; the pattern highlights the normal zonation of a secondary follicle and would fit a broadly expressed B-cell marker with stronger mantle zone expression. Findings are consistent with a normal secondary follicle.

ddx.vs: FL shows crowded follicles without a distinct mantle ring and BCL2 positivity within follicle centers, whereas here the mantle zone is well delineated.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: MCL shows a markedly widened mantle of cyclin D1-positive cells, which would need a specific stain rather than a pan-lymphoid pattern.
